description: Ministry of Parliamentary Reforms & Mass Media - The Right to Information Act, No. 12 of 2016 should be enforced w.e.f. 03.02.2017
reasoning: This gazette content announces the enforcement date of the Right to Information Act, No. 12 of 2016, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. It specifies when the provisions of this legislation come into effect for various public authorities, making it a statutory instrument implementation notice rather than a government personnel, structural, or other specialized administrative matter.
